## Summary

I resolved ticket T-4001 by investigating the failing pod deployment. The new invoice-api 3.8.0 pods were stuck in `CreateContainerConfigError` status because the deployment was trying to reference a missing Secret key `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. The fix is for the team to add this key to the `billing/invoice-api-secrets` Secret with the appropriate Stripe webhook secret value, then restart the rollout.
